title: fix(ci): drop the scripts test step that has no tests left
body:
## Summary

`bun run verify` fails on `main` at its first step, and with it every release gate.

534d6c98 moved the Claude review out to `niway-dev/agent-review` and deleted `scripts/claude-review.test.ts`, the only test under `scripts/`. `check-workflows` still ends in `bun test ./scripts/`, and `bun test` exits 1 when its filter matches no files ("filters did not match any test files"). So `check-workflows` fails, and so does every caller:

- `bun run verify` (Lefthook pre-push, `release-api.yml`, `release-web.yml`, `release-desktop.yml`)
- `pr-checks.yml` (`bun run check-workflows`, on release candidates)

This drops the empty step. The two workflow checks before it are unchanged.

## Verification

- `bun run check-workflows` → exit 0 ("All workflow eligibility checks passed", "Release workflow check passed").
- On `main` the same command exits 1 at `bun test ./scripts/`.

## How to test it yourself

1. On `main`, run `bun run check-workflows` from the repo root: it ends with "filters did not match any test files" and exit code 1.
2. On this branch, run the same command: both checks print their tables and it exits 0.
3. Optional: `bun run verify` now gets past its first step.
